milestones.title: Emails in your voice
lines: your details + real emails in settings
read drafts, then flip to send

modes.label: Drafts only
modes.note: nothing is sent; you read and approve

watch.title: Apify free plan
watch.text: First full run will likely stop on a credit/plan message. Fix: card + Starter plan at console.apify.com.

watch.title: Gmail sign-in expires every 7 days
watch.text: Switch the Google Cloud app from Testing to In production or the morning emails silently stop.

watch.title: Twilio A2P 10DLC
watch.text: Carriers block business texts until Twilio approves your brand and campaign. Days to weeks.

watch.title: Florida texting law
watch.text: Have a Florida attorney look at the texting approach. Email-first is the conservative start.

watch.title: Mailbox domain records
watch.text: SPF, DKIM, DMARC on the sending domain, or emails land in spam. Keep the cap at 25/day for two weeks.

watch.title: Web address + certificate
watch.text: A DNS name pointing at the server, Let's Encrypt, ports 80/443 open.

watch.title: Your 20 minutes a morning
watch.text: Read the drafts, send the good ones by hand, say what reads wrong. This is where it learns your voice.
